approval: Operator approved the read-only size census in chat on 2026-10-23 with the lab ceiling.
method: s3api list-objects-v2 over the production cache bucket, keeping only Size and LastModified; no keys or content were retained.
CloudWatch AWS/Lambda ConcurrentExecutions Maximum, hourly, 2026-09-24..2026-10-24, for the production read and write functions.

envelope.rule: 2 x observed p99 size and 1.5 x observed peak concurrency (SPEC deployment boundary)
envelope.alsoRun: the observed maximum (4616341 bytes), because synchronous Lambda invocation carries the base64-encoded body: 4616341 bytes encode to about 6155122, above the 6 MiB (6291456) request limit only with headers and event framing, so this size sits at the incumbent's ceiling and must be measured, not assumed

limits: Sizes are the stored compressed artifacts; they do not show request headers or event framing overhead.
Hourly maxima can under-report sub-hour bursts; the envelope multiplier covers part of that.
